member.name: LineStatusIconMarginBase.Class
member.summary: Provides the shared marker plumbing for line-status margins that draw a replaceable icon on every visible marked line and run a click action for it: the icon brush and geometry properties, the centered and font-scaled drawing, and the left-press handling that resolves the clicked line.

member.name: LineStatusIconMarginBase.Remarks
member.para: The margin draws with , scaled with the margin's font size and centered in the reserved width. The geometry is authored for the design font size and repositioned from its own bounds, so any authored origin works.

A left press resolves the visual line under the pointer - the click position comes from , which a subclass with an injectable click seam overrides - and invokes . A subclass that performed an action returns , which marks the press handled; a press that resolves to no line stays untouched.

The properties are registered here so sibling margins share one implementation; a derived margin registers its own icon defaults by overriding the property's default value. The reserved width and the marker scale are inherited from and follow the margin's font size.

member.name: IconBrushProperty
member.remarks: The base registration defaults to a neutral system gray; a derived margin overrides the property's default value with its own default icon color.

member.name: IconGeometryProperty
member.remarks: The base registration defaults to an empty geometry, which draws nothing; a derived margin overrides the property's default value with its own icon geometry.

member.name: IconBrush
member.summary: Gets or sets the brush used to draw the marker icon.
member.remarks: A derived margin overrides the property's default value with its own default and documents that default on its type; hosts should set the brush to their theme's marker color.

member.name: IconGeometry
member.summary: Gets or sets the geometry used to draw the marker icon.
member.remarks: A derived margin overrides the property's default value with its own default icon and documents that default on its type. The geometry is authored for the design font size and scaled and repositioned from its own bounds, so any authored origin works.

member.name: ResolveClickPosition
member.summary: Resolves the click position for a press event, in the margin's coordinate space.
member.remarks: A subclass with an injectable click seam (a test seam, because a synthetic event carries no deterministic position) overrides this member to consult it.
member.returns: The click position in the margin's coordinate space.

member.name: MarkerLayout
member.summary: The parts of a marker transform that do not vary from marked line to marked line.
member.remarks: HasIcon reports whether the icon geometry has bounds and therefore paints; IconHeight is the scaled icon height, used to center the icon in the line box; and BaseMatrix carries the scale and horizontal placement every marker shares, so a marker adds its icon's vertical offset to the matrix's offset-Y to place itself.

member.name: OnIconClicked
member.summary: Runs the margin's click action for the icon of the clicked visual line.
member.remarks: The call runs for a left press that resolved to a visual line; returning marks the press handled. The base implementation does nothing.
member.param: The visual line under the click position.
The click position in the margin's coordinate space.
member.returns: when the press was handled; otherwise, .

member.name: TryGetVisualLineAt
member.summary: Resolves the visual line at the specified position in the margin's coordinate space.
member.param: The position in the margin's coordinate space.
The resolved visual line when one was found.
member.returns: when the position resolved to a visual line; otherwise, .

member.name: GetMarkerLayout
member.summary: Gets the marker layout for the current marker properties, computing it when the cached one is stale.
member.param: The icon geometry currently assigned, which the caller already read.
member.returns: The marker layout for the current marker properties.

member.name: CreateMarkerLayout
member.summary: Computes the parts of a marker transform that every marked line shares.
member.param: The icon geometry to compute the layout for.
member.returns: The computed marker layout; the default layout when the icon has no bounds.
